saw_lines: Players don’t compare booking apps on features. They join whatever app their group already uses, then rarely switch.
So the first app a group tries keeps the booking, and your ads give the captain no reason to switch today.
Your 0 of 30 live ads carry a proof number, so take one review count or orders shipped figure and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Nov 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a club captain has nothing to trust before clicking. Choose one review count or orders shipped figure, put it on every creative, and open three new ads with it.

6 of your 24 copy ads open on the same THE PADELLERS erfahre jetzt line, so a new reader hears one story. Test two new openers against it: one for club managers, one for players booking tennis or squash.
0 of 24 copy ads carry an offer, so a first time player has no reason to book today. Give new players one booking offer, such as a discounted first court booking, and open two new ads with it.

27 of your ads have run 60+ days, so new buyers keep seeing one message. Build three more versions of the oldest video, live since November 2024, changing the first line, and run them beside the original.

ads_1: New openers for club managers and players, tested against the current opener
